== History ==

One of the best finnish clans in the late 90s. Founded 15th of November 1998, disbanded 11th of May 1999.
The members would later go to {{flag/fi}} [[Clan MalFunction]], {{flag/fi}} [[The Viper Squad]] and {{flag/fi}} [[Zetor]].
